title: fix: allow Google Analytics in Content-Security-Policy
head: nav/analytics-institutional-dropdown
body:
## Why

Live verification of the GA4 integration (PR #16) showed gtag was blocked in production by the Content-Security-Policy defined in `vercel.json`. The console error:

> Loading the script 'https://www.googletagmanager.com/gtag/js?id=G-00N56623LQ' violates the following Content Security Policy directive: "script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://assets.vercel.com https://va.vercel-scripts.com https://assets.calendly.com"

## What changed

`vercel.json` CSP updated:
- `script-src` — added `https://www.googletagmanager.com` for the gtag.js loader
- `connect-src` — added `https://www.google-analytics.com`, `https://analytics.google.com`, `https://stats.g.doubleclick.net` for GA4 data beacons
- `img-src` — added `https://www.google-analytics.com` for the GA4 tracking pixel

All other CSP directives are unchanged, so Calendly, Vercel Analytics, and Sentry integration remain intact.
